profile.description: Alro S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells aluminum in Romania, other European countries, other non-European countries, the United States, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Alumina, Primary Aluminium, and Processed Aluminium. The company offers homogenized AlMgSi bars, aluminum and aluminum alloy slabs, and aluminum and aluminum alloy wire; aluminum and aluminum alloy sheets and strips, coated aluminum alloy sheets and strips, and extruded profiles; and aluminum and aluminum alloy plates, including heat-treated and non-heat-treated. It also provides flat-rolled products, including flat or embossed coils, sheets, plates, and profiles of aluminum; wire rod, slabs, billets, and ingots; and CutSmart systems. The company serves aerospace, auto and maritime, construction, general engineering, cables and power supply, and electronic industries. Alro S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Slatina, Romania. Alro S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Vimetco PLC.
